airtouchKiosk.scope: Explicit surface.kiosk opt-in for the specialist AirTouch overview only; existing visual worlds and HA permissions are preserved.
airtouchKiosk.nativeIntegration: Kiosk Mode 15.0.0; sidebar hidden only on the selected generated dashboard for the validated unique-name nonadministrator account. Header hidden only on the overview; native control subviews retain header and Back.
airtouchKiosk.escape: Settings opens a native Settings subview with HA chrome, Profile/app settings and Panel mode return. Native HA navigation keeps taps in the Companion app. No cache locking.

Documentation-sync finding resolved in DESIGN.md and the surface contract.
airtouchKiosk.limits: 0.8.12 prepared locally; live 0.8.11 unchanged. Physical tablet and actual AirTouch operation unverified. Automatic idle/Ambient/Dark and wake-return policy not implemented; default-dashboard/app startup not configured.

airtouchOverview.material: Dark neutral overview and slate inactive edges. Existing native Climate/detail navy/cyan palette remains unchanged. Shared panel type/radii/focus continue the existing system.
airtouchOverview.activity: Blue only for reported operation while state is not off, or selected household navigation. Off overrides stale hvac_action; enabled zones are counted separately from activity.
airtouchOverview.imagery: panel-room.jpg reused for Climate/Home. Four new contextual decorative JPEGs embed exact prompts/origin; panel-imagery.json carries source/output hashes. No household photograph or capability/feed evidence.
airtouchOverview.navigation: House plus saved people primary; Ambient and kiosk Settings secondary accessible icon shortcuts. No invented members or avatars.
airtouchOverview.detector: Ran once; no errors. Pinned Roboto and advisory new overview tokens are intentional scoped choices, not a parallel design system.

narrative.overview:
Preserve the incumbent Home Assistant-like administration interface: compact system typography, blue actions, neutral bordered cards and progressive disclosure. The household screen setup extends this identity rather than introducing another visual world.

Home Starter owns the administrator setup and its non-operating layout preview. Generated household dashboards use native Home Assistant cards and the viewer's theme. Their chrome, typography, card styling and sidebar are Home Assistant's responsibility; do not treat those screenshot values as Home Starter tokens. V0.3 establishes admission, hierarchy and generation boundaries, not a finished visual design for every household profile. Operational limits live in [SURFACES.md](home_starter/SURFACES.md).

**Scoped specialist world: AirTouch household panel.** The explicitly requested reference-led AirTouch overview uses a dark neutral photographic overview, white Roboto and blue reserved for operating Climate and selected household navigation. Its direction comes from the supplied `home_starter_airtouch_reference.png` and the contract in `.impeccable/surfaces/airtouch-panel.md`. The overview uses scoped neutral tokens; Climate and detail subviews retain their existing navy/cyan palette and generic room backdrop around preserved native controls. Do not replace their still-used panel tokens with overview colors. Administration retains Code-led Operate and Home Assistant chrome retains native styling. This world remains scoped to the specialist landscape panel.
keyCharacteristics: Explicit settings, preview and publication states.
Native household controls with room-based compression.
Quiet exceptions and a dedicated air-conditioning hierarchy.

rules.name: AirTouch content bounds
rules.body: In the specialist overview, the base bottom row uses minmax(150px,.7fr) to retain detail text. At container widths up to 720px, Call and Cameras share an auto-height row. Compact landscape applies through 750px viewport height at widths above 720px and uses its existing 112px bottom row.

rules.name: AirTouch kiosk escape
rules.body: The explicit specialist-only `surface.kiosk` option uses installed Kiosk Mode for the validated dedicated nonadministrator account with a unique display name. It hides the sidebar only on that generated dashboard and hides the header only on its overview; native control subviews retain their header and Back target. The footer adds Settings, which uses native HA navigation to open a Settings subview with HA chrome, Profile/app settings and a Panel mode return. Tile and footer taps use button-card's supported navigation helper so they remain in the Companion app. Administrator chrome and other dashboards retain their existing presentation. This changes presentation only, with no permissions change or cache locking.

rules.name: AirTouch Climate continuity
rules.body: Retain the established navy/cyan native Climate route and existing room backdrop. Preserve native configurations, room/device grouping and Back; the neutral overview refinement does not restyle this route.

rules.name: Room climate hierarchy
rules.body: Pair only a unique AirTouch zone/damper sharing registry device evidence. Full room name and thermometer reading lead, native full-width +/- setpoints and compact mode icons follow, and a readonly damper icon/bar/percentage stays in that room. Keep explanatory words in accessible labels/tooltips. Omit missing room temperature; expose unavailable damper meaning. Stack system above rooms through 1100px to preserve control width.

dos: Do preserve the incumbent admin tokens and progressive disclosure.
Do scope neutral overview tokens and contextual photographs to the AirTouch overview; retain the existing navy/cyan Climate and detail worlds and native controls.
Do distinguish reported climate activity, selected operating mode, enabled zones and unavailable evidence; Off overrides stale activity.
Do distinguish layout preview, verified publication and native control verification.
Do compress admitted household items into room summaries and native subviews.
Do retain person-versus-physical-screen preference ownership and suitability explanations.
donts: Don't apply admin CSS tokens to native Home Assistant dashboards.
Don't show normal-state exception sections or populate unsupported catalogue sources.
Don't introduce control widgets or room links into generated wall content.
Don't treat duplicate test sidebar links or simulated host chrome as Home Starter design patterns.
